'''Bean Hotpot''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

'''Note:''' this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients.

Bean Hotpot may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Bean Hotpot may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Bean Hotpot per year on [[Demetrius]]' birthday, [[Summer|Summer 19]].

==Bundles==
Bean Hotpot is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Bean Hotpot is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Bean Hotpot is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt020|link=Tailoring{{!}}Green Vest|class=inline}}. It is a green dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the green dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

Bean Hotpot is not used in any [[quests]].
